reason.specifics: Routed analysis (gemini-pro, $0.003) recommended Opus medium for Session 3 over the original ai-assignment Sonnet-low recommendation. Session 3 authors `docs/platform-overview.md`, the canonical entry-point doc for future platform consumers — high-leverage synthesis from project-guidance + lessons-learned + this session's refresh log. Weak initial drafts trigger Round-1 verification re-work cycles; Opus medium reduces that risk for a small additional reasoning cost. Operator may swap to Sonnet medium if context permits.

notes: Session 2 was documentation refresh — 15 docs routed for refresh assessment; 8 received material edits (with Round-1 follow-ups producing 9 total edited files), 5 truly NO CHANGES NEEDED, 1 deleted as a stale duplicate, 1 stale-flagged. The 3 verification rounds documented a useful failure mode: the verifier consistently flagged real issues but also produced one context-gap finding per round (Round 1: SystemAdmin Authorize example never existed in the README; Round 3: 'Out of scope' assertion was about a transient verification-prompt artifact, not the deliverable). The disagreement-resolution procedure worked as designed — record_adjudication captured the dismissal for tuning visibility. Cost discipline note: the routed-cost-vs-orchestrator-cost balance for this session was lopsided toward orchestrator-side reasoning since Opus high was the active orchestrator running multi-step file work; future documentation-refresh sessions should honor the spec-sized Sonnet-low orchestrator unless explicitly overridden.
